description: This file defines a service for aggregating LLM (Large Language Model) costs by agent name, including functions for resolving collection names, building MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different data schemas, and a fallback in-process aggregation method. It exports functions to retrieve aggregated costs and handle various data schemas and errors.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates
methods.description: Determines collection names from environment variables and defaults, prioritizing 'llm-costs' and 'llm_events'.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for flat schema documents with various agent and cost fields, normalizing and summing costs.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for documents with an Agents array, normalizing agent names and summing costs.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp
methods.description: In-process fallback aggregator that processes documents with Agents array to compute total costs per agent, preserving display casing.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to aggregate LLM costs by agent from the database, with fallbacks to in-process aggregation if needed.
